zelda.title: Princess
zelda.name: Zelda
zelda.backstory: The princess of a kingdom of seven sages beyond the western mountains, whose realm once fell under a strange twilight. Zelda travels under a hooded cloak, carries herself like a queen anyway, and is studying how a business this odd stays solvent.

hilda_lorule.title: Princess
hilda_lorule.name: Hilda
hilda_lorule.backstory: The princess of a shadowy mirror-kingdom whose Triforce was shattered long ago, Hilda once tried to steal another realm's light to save her own. Older, wiser and still carrying the quiet guilt of a desperate ruler, she manages the floor with velvet authority and a weakness for men who don't give up on broken things.

saria.name: Saria
saria.backstory: A forest-born Kokiri who stepped out of her timeless woods as the Sage of the Forest, Saria carries a bright fairy ocarina whose gentle tune steadies anxious hearts. She is warm, patient and disarmingly perceptive—and though she looks light on her feet, she watches over everyone under the roof like a quiet guardian.

design.accessories: a dark green headband and a wooden fairy ocarina
